nodes.description: Private uint256 randomNumber, seeded at construction from keccak256(now) % 10 + 1, making it timestamp dependent and publicly derivable.
Public uint256 prizeFund, updated in StartGame to this.balance, tracking the accumulated jackpot.
Public uint256 minBet initialised to 0.1 ether; gate for accepting bets and settable by onlyOwner.
Address owner initialised from msg.sender at deployment; used by the onlyOwner access-control check.
Public GameHistory[] log array that stores every player address and guessed number.
changeMinBet(uint256 _newMinBet) external onlyOwner; writes the new minimum bet value.
StartGame(uint256 _number) public payable; records the guess in log, pays out the whole balance via msg.sender.transfer on a correct guess, then reseeds randomNumber from now.
withdaw(uint256 _am) public onlyOwner; sends _am wei from the contract balance to the owner address.
Anonymous payable fallback function that silently accepts ether and increases the prize fund.
msg.sender; attacker controlled caller used for the owner assignment, player identity and the payout recipient.
block.timestamp (now) used as the only entropy source for the randomNumber seed.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) inside StartGame: external value transfer to an untrusted address driven by a guessable random number.
owner.transfer(_am) inside withdaw: external value transfer of a caller supplied amount drained from the contract balance.
Parameter _newMinBet of changeMinBet, the new minimum bet written directly into state.
Parameter _number of StartGame, the player's guess compared against randomNumber.
Parameter _am of withdaw, the amount of wei transferred to the owner.
Memory struct GameHistory built in StartGame from msg.sender and _number before being pushed into log.

edges.reason: owner is initialised from msg.sender, so the deployed owner identity depends on the untrusted caller.
msg.sender is written into the gameHistory record and used as the payout recipient inside StartGame.
The untrusted caller address is the target of the msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) payout.
randomNumber is derived deterministically from block.timestamp, allowing miners/validators to predict or influence the lottery outcome.
randomNumber is read by StartGame for the (_number == randomNumber) win check.
StartGame reseeds randomNumber with a new timestamp-derived hash after every bet, propagating the weak entropy source.
changeMinBet writes the new value into the minBet state variable.
The _newMinBet parameter flows into the changeMinBet function body.
The _newMinBet parameter is stored directly into state variable minBet.
The _number parameter is the player supplied guess processed by StartGame.
The _am parameter is the amount forwarded by withdaw.
withdaw executes the owner.transfer(_am) external value transfer without a reentrancy guard.
When the guess matches randomNumber, StartGame transfers the entire contract balance to msg.sender before finishing its state updates.
The external transfer to msg.sender can re-enter StartGame between the win branch and the randomNumber/prizeFund updates.
prizeFund is refreshed from this.balance at the end of StartGame.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before withdaw body execution.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before changeMinBet body execution.
msg.sender is stored into the local gameHistory struct field player.
The local gameHistory struct is pushed into the public log array.

normalization_plan.reason: _newMinBet is only a formal argument whose sole purpose is to be written into minBet inside changeMinBet.
_number is only meaningful inside StartGame where it is validated against randomNumber and logged.
_am exists only to parameterise the owner.transfer amount executed by withdaw.
gameHistory is a transient struct assembled and immediately pushed into log during StartGame.
